prompt: If a product is good and it meets people's needs, people will buy it. Therefore, advertising is unnecessary and is no more than a form of entertainment. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Some people argue that high-quality products naturally attract customers, making advertising unnecessary and little more than a form of entertainment. While product quality is undoubtedly the foundation of long-term business success, I strongly disagree that advertising has become irrelevant. In my view, advertising remains essential because it informs consumers and promotes competition in the marketplace.

One important reason advertising continues to play a vital role is that consumers cannot purchase products they are unaware of. Regardless of how innovative or useful a product may be, it is unlikely to succeed if potential buyers never learn of its existence. Advertising enables businesses to introduce new products, explain their features, and highlight how they differ from competing alternatives. For example, a company that develops an environmentally friendly household cleaner may struggle to reach customers without advertising, despite offering a superior product. Consequently, effective marketing helps bridge the gap between producers and consumers by ensuring valuable products receive the attention they deserve.

Admittedly, some advertisements are designed primarily to entertain audiences or create a memorable brand image. However, this does not mean they lack practical value. In addition to increasing brand recognition, advertising encourages companies to compete by improving product quality, pricing, and customer service in order to attract buyers. Take the smartphone industry as an example. Major manufacturers invest heavily in advertising not only to promote new features but also to distinguish their products in an increasingly competitive market. Consumers ultimately benefit from this competition through greater choice and continuous innovation.

In conclusion, although a well-designed product is essential for commercial success, advertising remains far more than a source of entertainment. It plays a crucial role in informing consumers, supporting fair competition, and helping innovative products reach the people who can benefit from them.
